content: Admission Inquiry Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Internal Complaints Committee ABOUT ICC Safe, confidential & responsive support In pursuance of “University Grants Commission (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal of Sexual harassment of Women Employees and Students in higher educational institutions) Regulations, 2015 read with Sexual Harassment of Women at workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act 2013, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU) has constituted the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) to deal with complaint relating the sexual harassment of women employees and students at the university. To prevent the victim from being persuaded to withdraw their accusations by the offender(s), the committee accepts complaints from victims and maintains their confidentiality. The committee firmly deals with all instances of sexual harassment and assault. The committee not only pursues retributive measures against sexual harassment offender(s) but also makes an effort to raise awareness of it through sensitization initiatives. The ICC addresses the problems immediately and takes appropriate actions, helping employees and students feel entirely safe on campus. COMMITTEE OBJECTIVES Objectives of the ICC Objective 01 To increase awareness of sexual harassment through educational programs that support and promote a respectful and secure campus environment. Objective 02 To deal with situations of discrimination and sexual harassment against women promptly to ensure support services for the harmed and the cessation of the harassment. Inform complainants of the informal and formal mechanisms of settlement as outlined by the Cell. Objective 03 To offer an unbiased, secretive, and encouraging setting for any victims of sexual abuse. Objective 04 Advocate suitable sanctions against the offender. Objective 05 To inform people about the support and counseling options available on our campus. Objective 06 Ensuring that faculty, staff, and students have access to the most recent and complete resources on sexual harassment and assault. GOVERNANCE STRUCTURE ICC Members Chairperson Prof. (Dr.) Nandini Chaudhari Call 7861805161 icc@kpgu.ac.in Member Secretary Dr. Camy Bhura Call 7600058350 camybhura.kspr@kpgu.ac.in Member Ms. Apoorva Shah Call 9428066920 apoorvashah.cse.kset@kpgu.ac.in Member Dr. Rita Mahapatra Call 9879667212 ritamahapatra.kss@kpgu.ac.in Member Ms. Palak Landge Call 7861805322 osd@kpgu.edu.in Member Ms. Arpita Pandya Call 7861805196 establishment@kpgu.edu.in NGO Representative Ms. Rachana Parikh Call 9824674223 rachana@psca.in info@kpgu.edu.in Student Member Ms. Riddhima Thank Call 9687220106 Riddhima.thank@gmail.com Student Member Ms. Kashish Patel Call 9875012106 Kashishpatel1606@gmail.com Student Member Ms. Vaidehi Raj Call 9106599587 jkmvaidehiraj@gmail.com COMPLAINT PROCEDURE How to Submit An aggrieved person (who has been victimized) may launch the complaints by: Sending an email icc@kpgu.ac.in Written Application A formal written/printed complaint may also be submitted. Important Guidelines Submit the complaint within three months from the date of the incident and in case of a series of incidents within a period of three months from the date of the last incident. You have to mention all your details like name, designation, mobile no & mail Id, enrolment no in case of student. Mention the incident description like date, time, location, respondent’s name, working relationships etc. Committee shall follow the KPGU policy on prevention of sexual harassment. This session helped in increasing knowledge on gynecological issues and necessary screening tests to be done at the earliest among the women, which can help to reduce the incidence of gynaecological cancer. 05/12/2024 Session on "Gender, Respect and Equality" ICC had hosted an eye-opening session on "Gender, Respect and Equality : Breaking Barriers" by Ms. Amita Prabhin, from Mellyah Skills Education. She shared practical strategies to break barriers and promote inclusivity on 05/12/2024, Thursday. 07/03/2024 International Women’s Day: Invest in Women - Accelerate Progress On March 07 2024, the world marked International Women's Day (IWD) to renew collective commitment to achieving gender equality. The event was graced by distinguished university leadership along with 181-ABHYAM Women Helpline team and SHE team, Vadodara. 05/03/2024 Empowerment Through Art: Poster Making Competition The poster competition titled "The Empowerment Through Art" was formulated with a comprehensive aim of fostering self-awareness among university staff and students on 5 March and 6 March 2024. 09/12/2023 Awareness Program on Women in the Workplace Menopause awareness seminar was organised on World Menopause Day on 18/10/2023 to raise awareness, eliminate stigma, and emphasise the resources available to help women improve physical and mental wellbeing. 18/10/2023 Menopause Awareness Seminar An awareness program was held on 17/04/2023 for educating participants about the awareness of sexual harassment of women in the workplace and highlighting the importance and significance of the act. 17/04/2023 Sanitary Vending Machine Awareness Program An awareness program was held from 9/12/23 to 14/12/23 based on UGC Guidelines, highlighting key elements of workplace sexual harassment, preventive authorities, sanitary pad disposal bins and vending machines.
